findings.title: Downloads and runs programs during install

metadata.description: An extremely fast JavaScript and CSS bundler and minifier.

aiReview.summary: esbuild@0.28.2 runs a postinstall script that fetches or installs a platform-specific native esbuild binary and validates it; it does not attempt to steal data or run untrusted remote code beyond downloading from the npm registry and checking SHA-256 hashes.
aiReview.reasoning: I inspected install.js, bin/esbuild, and lib/main.js. The postinstall script (install.js) determines the correct platform package, attempts to resolve or install the platform-specific @esbuild/* package, and falls back to downloading the package tarball from the official npm registry. It validates downloaded binaries using stored SHA-256 hashes before writing them to disk and uses child_process only to run npm or validate the binary with --version. The CLI wrapper (bin/esbuild) and lib/main spawn or exec the platform binary to provide the service; this is expected behavior for a bundler that uses a native executable. There is no network exfiltration, secret collection, or execution of arbitrary remote scripts; network activity targets registry.npmjs.org and uses integrity checks.

evidence.explanation: downloadDirectlyFromNPM constructs URL to registry.npmjs.org and downloads the package tarball.
maybeOptimizePackage and download/install flow choose binary path and produce toPath; uses require.resolve to find platform package.
binaryIntegrityCheck computes SHA-256 and compares to hashes from package.json before accepting the binary.
validateBinaryVersion runs child_process.execFileSync with --version to ensure the binary version matches package.json.
installUsingNPM runs `npm install ...` via child_process.execSync to install optional platform package when needed.
If ESBUILD_BINARY_PATH override is set, the wrapper writes a small JS shim that execFileSyncs the binary (expected behavior).
execFileSync is used to invoke the esbuild native binary for CLI usage.
ensureServiceIsRunning spawns the platform binary as a long-lived child process to provide build service.

findingAssessments.explanation: postinstall runs install.js to set up a platform-specific native binary; expected for native modules.
execFileSync is used to run the binary with --version to validate version; not used to run untrusted code.
downloadDirectlyFromNPM downloads a tgz from registry.npmjs.org and performs a SHA-256 integrity check before writing the binary.
execFileSync invokes the local esbuild binary to implement the CLI; expected behavior.
child_process.spawn creates a persistent esbuild service process for performance; this is normal for this package.
